player_prompt.intro:
Aʊ kɛlɛ Blackjack naalɛ taa dealer.
Aʊ lacɩnɛ wɛɛ lɛ, alɩwa 21 ŋgʊ kɛlɛkɛ pɩlɩʊ.
Aʊ taa ŋgbɛyɛ, se '[Hit]' pɩlɩʊ kɛlɛkɛ pɩlɩʊ yaa '[Stand]' pɩlɩʊ tɔm.
J/Q/K = 10 pɔŋ; A = 11 yaa 1, pɩlɩʊ pɩkɛ naalɛ.
